name: Example: Terrain
description: A 64 m terrain block generated by the toolkit's rulesTerrain from seeded noise: grass, scree past 32°, snow above 6 m and triplanar cliffs past 45°, laid into its vertex colours by rules on the CPU with a horizon AO, a heightfield collider, and the toolkit's procedural rocks scattered on its scree. Balls dropped on it roll down its slopes; Space drops another one.
